$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. loop-listing.v1 is a CLIENT-SIDE / STATIC-REGISTRY artifact only. Per the master build brief's hard scope boundary, this build-out does NOT build a hosted marketplace service, accounts, reviews, or moderation storage — this schema describes the mutable per-loopId presentation record maintained alongside the signed Git index (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §11: 'A static browse site. Generated from the index at build time... no server-side query engine, no per-request computation over private state') and updated the same way an index entry is: submission by pull request, merge is publication. FB-RAT-MKT-003: 'Marketplace listings are mutable presentation records; referenced releases are immutable content-addressed artifacts.' §4: 'A LoopListing is mutable descriptive metadata (title, description, category, screenshots, the currently-recommended release pointer)... A listing MAY reference a stable channel and a pre-release channel simultaneously. Removing a listing MUST NOT mutate, invalidate, or retroactively alter a release a user has already downloaded; the release's identity is its digest, not its presence in any listing.'
title: LoopListing
description: loop-listing.v1 — the mutable presentation record for a loop family, referencing one or more immutable loop-release.v1 entries (loop-release.schema.json) by their identity tuples (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §4). compatibilityDeclaration on this record is creator-declared discovery metadata (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §7's discovery filters), explicitly distinct from the fuller, per-release compatibility.json LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md governs in detail (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §10) — this schema does not redefine that document's ten-axis vocabulary, only cross-references it, and is UNVERIFIED METADATA by default per FB-RAT-CMP-007.

listingId.description: Stable listing identity, independent of any single referenced release (FB-RAT-MKT-003 — a listing outlives and outlasts individual releases).

referencedReleases.description: One or more loop-release.v1 identity tuples this listing presents (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §4: 'A listing MAY reference a stable channel and a pre-release channel simultaneously.'). Exactly one entry SHOULD have recommended=true per distinct channel — this schema does not enforce that cardinality structurally (it is a discovery-UX convention, not a content-integrity property); see this schema's adversarial/ fixtures for a schema-valid case with zero or multiple recommended entries per channel.

displayName.description: Human-readable title (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §4 'title'). Model-directed-string scanning (LOOP-PKG-008, loop-validation-rules.v1.json) and invisible-Unicode rejection (LOOP-PKG-006) apply to this field at publication time (§10) — this schema validates shape only, not content safety; see this schema's adversarial/ fixtures.

description.description: Free-text listing description. Same LOOP-PKG-006/LOOP-PKG-008 publication-time scanning applies as for displayName — this is exactly the kind of human/model-readable marketplace surface §10's prompt-risk review (LOOP-PKG-008) exists to catch, since a listing description is read by both humans browsing the static site and by any AI assistant a user might ask to summarize or compare listings.

category.description: Discovery category (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §7). Modeled as an open string, not a closed enum — no ratified document in this corpus freezes a category vocabulary; §7 states discovery filters SHOULD be 'derived from declared package manifest data wherever possible' but does not enumerate a fixed category list. A future registry-hygiene pass MAY freeze one; not done here to avoid inventing a taxonomy nobody has ratified.

lastUpdatedUtc.description: UTC instant this presentation record was last changed via a merged PR against the registry repository (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §11).

publisherKeyFingerprint.description: Optional convenience mirror of the publisher identity common to referencedReleases, for discovery-site rendering without dereferencing every release. Not authoritative — a client's actual trust decision is always made per-release against that release's own signatureRef (loop-release.schema.json), never against this field.

packageDigest.description: Duplicated locally rather than $ref'd against loop-release.schema.json, per this corpus's standalone-schema-file convention (each schema validates without reaching into a sibling file).

channel.description: Matches the referenced loop-release.v1's own releaseChannel (loop-release.schema.json), duplicated here so a discovery UI can group/filter without dereferencing every release.

recommended.description: Whether this is 'the currently-recommended release pointer' for its channel (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §4).

verified.description: MUST default false and MUST NOT be set true without evidenceRefs (see allOf below) — FB-RAT-CMP-007 (EXPERIMENTAL, cited here as already-scoped context per LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §8, not re-ratified): 'Treat creator-declared device/language compatibility as unverified metadata until backed by fixtures or explicit shared receipts... A creator claim without such evidence MUST be labeled declared, never verified.' A listing whose creator has supplied no fixtures or shared receipts MUST leave this false; the UI-facing label for false is 'declared', never 'verified', per that same decision text.

declaredAxes.description: Open map of compatibility-axis name to creator-declared value, for discovery-filter rendering (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §7: 'estimated cost/duration, read/write/destructive authority, engine version, test coverage, verification level, license, publisher, and compatibility'). The ten-axis vocabulary itself (schema, engine, node type, capability, model class, execution target, platform/distribution, device, resource, policy) is owned by LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §2 (FB-RAT-CMP-001) and capability-ids.v1.json / model-capability-vocabulary.v1.json for the capability/model-class axes specifically — not redefined or re-enumerated here as a closed key set, so an additive axis never requires a schema change.

engineVersionRange.description: SemVer range summary mirrored from the recommended release's manifest.compatibilityDeclaration.engineVersionRange (loop-package-manifest.schema.json), for the §7 'engine version' discovery filter without dereferencing the release. Cross-references capability-ids.v1.json's engineVersion object; not re-derived here.

evidenceRefs.description: Fixture references or shared-receipt identifiers/URLs supporting a verified=true claim (LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md owns the full shared-receipt shape; this schema does not redefine it, only points at it by reference string). REQUIRED non-empty when verified is true — see allOf below.
